verdict.rationale: Gecko's PR checks separate findings introduced by a pull request from pre-existing ones, which is a documented baseline-style behavior for new-vs-existing issues. The API and MCP tools also mention triaging findings, but never say that triage can mark findings as false positives or suppress them from future alerts. missing for 10: explicit ignore/suppress or false-positive dismissal that persists across scans, documentation that checks and alerts fire only on new findings, baseline behavior outside PR scans, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can baseline or ignore existing and false-positive findings so only new issues alert

citations.quote: Findings introduced by the PR are separated from pre-existing ones, so reviewers focus on what the change adds.
